name: Narrative rotation crossover
hypothesis: Buy the newly stronger eligible narrative basket when relative flow and price ranks cross registered thresholds.
spec: Setup: Capital may shift from a weakening narrative to one gaining independent demand. Entry: Buy the newly stronger eligible narrative basket when relative flow and price ranks cross registered thresholds. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on rank reversal or portfolio risk limits. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time narrative membership and flow data beyond the six exchange-listed memecoins
